system.notes: SR2E p.213. The new men are nothing more than gangsters and ruffians. The old bosses prefer influence-peddling and embarrassment tactics over the crude intimidation and violence favored by the new blood. Still philosophizing and courteous, if always seeking to spread a veneer of culture and gentility over his rough edges. Full stat block: see the "Yakuza Boss" actor in the SR2E Contacts (NPCs) compendium.
